per_requirement.extracted_requirement: UI list view shall use distinct visual indicators (e.g., color-coding) so that users can scan and distinguish case statuses (pending, escalated, closed) without opening each case.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The list of dispute cases that are displayed after a search is performed must be color coded for easy identification of dispute cases based upon the dispute case status.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Small UI actions (screen transitions and simple searches) shall complete within 5 seconds as perceived by the user under normal load.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The maximum wait time for a user navigating from one screen to another within the Disputes application shall be no more than 5 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The dispute system shall display transaction, cardholder (member), and merchant information live from their authoritative source systems rather than relying on stale local copies.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall interface with the Statement Database. The Statement Database provides the transaction details to the Disputes System. All transaction details must be obtained from the Statement Database'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Access to cases and case actions shall be restricted by portfolio and role so users only see and act on cases they are authorized for (least privilege).
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes System must prevent users from accessing any dispute cases that do not belong to their cardholder base.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall enforce role-based authorization for initiating disputes and require manager/senior approval for higher-risk actions (e.g., large-amount chargebacks) via an in-case digital approval workflow.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall ensure that only users with the appropriate access level are allowed to initiate dispute requests.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: All case actions shall be recorded in an auditable history including actor identity, timestamp, a short reason/note, and before-and-after values for changed fields.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application must maintain a detailed history of every action that a user takes on a dispute case. This ensures a complete audit trail if questions arise later on with regard to a particular dispute case.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: External users shall be presented with a restricted view that hides sensitive member data (e.g., full account numbers and other personal info) while exposing only the information necessary for their interaction.
UI layout, controls, and generated member-facing correspondence shall conform to the corporate style/branding guidelines to ensure consistency and trust.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall comply with the corporate standards for user interface creation for internally and externally used applications.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Color indicators and UI-visible status must be consistent with the logged status in the audit/history; any change in status visible in the UI must have a corresponding recorded event showing who made the change and when.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The list of dispute cases that are displayed after a search is performed must be color coded for easy identification of dispute cases based upon the dispute case status.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall prevent users from seeing cases outside their portfolio and log any attempted cross-portfolio access; visibility errors shall occur less than monthly (target: zero incidents) and be investigate-able.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes System must prevent users from accessing any dispute cases that do not belong to their cardholder base.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall allow attaching evidence (files, scanned receipts, and call recording links) to cases and ensure attachments are stored and linked reliably to the corresponding case entry.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall ensure that only users with the appropriate access level are allowed to initiate dispute requests.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Generated correspondence (letters/emails) shall be produced from templates and must reference the same transaction and member details shown in the case; generated outputs shall be reviewable before sending.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application must maintain a detailed history of every action that a user takes on a dispute case. This ensures a complete audit trail if questions arise later on with regard to a particular dispute case.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Planned maintenance shall be scheduled in predictable windows (e.g., Sundays 01:00–05:00 and daily 03:00–04:00 local time) with at least 24 hours advance notice via email or in-app banner for non-emergency extended maintenance.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall be available 24x7x365 with the exception of the following scheduled maintenance windows. Monday â€“ Saturday 3:00am to 4:00am EST Sunday 1:00amd to 5:00am EST'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Planned maintenance exceptions are acceptable only with advance notice; emergency outages are permitted but planned longer maintenance must be communicated at least one day ahead.
Search functionality shall support partial/more flexible matching so users can find cases using partial identifiers or incomplete information.
The system shall persist user-specific saved searches/filters so users can restore frequently used queries each morning to reduce repetitive setup.
The system shall preserve the user's context/state during a call (e.g., not lose open case selection or cursor position) to avoid having to 'find my place' mid-call.
The system shall provide role-based views that prevent vendor users from editing member account details or initiating adjustments while allowing them limited verification access.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall ensure that only users with the appropriate access level are allowed to initiate dispute requests.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Approval workflows and any enforced controls must be non-bypassable and the system must log any attempt to bypass or override approvals.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application must maintain a detailed history of every action that a user takes on a dispute case. This ensures a complete audit trail if questions arise later on with regard to a particular dispute case.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall surface failures or outages gracefully during calls (clear messaging) and provide an alternative workflow or contact guidance when authoritative data sources are unavailable.
Attachments and sensitive data must be protected according to privacy requirements (e.g., masked in external views and encrypted at rest/in transit).
Search and list rendering shall remain responsive (meet performance targets) even when integrating live data from external authoritative systems.
